verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships its own AI agents (Breeze), so letting users connect external MCP servers to those agents is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents HubSpot's own MCP servers, the CRM MCP server and the Developer MCP server, which serve HubSpot data to other agents. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows HubSpot consuming tools from third-party MCP servers.
